verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own automation primitives: a scheduler for running background workflows (convex-docs-60), crons on all plans (convex-docs-57), and a 'workflow' capability on its homepage (convex-docs-62). These give time-based and code-scheduled automatic actions. However, nothing in the evidence shows declarative rules that fire on data or app events, such as database triggers or change hooks. missing for 10: documented event-driven triggers (e.g., on-insert/on-update rules), a rule-definition mechanism beyond code-level scheduling, in-depth docs on scheduler/workflow behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
